c.v: SENSOR (ALWAYS_ON) represents the registers, which will not be reset due to the power down of RTC_PERI domain.
SENSOR (RTC_PERI) represents the registers, which will be reset due to the power down of RTC_PERI domain.
SENSOR (DIG_PERI) represents the registers, which will be reset due to the power down of digital domain.
The abbreviations given in column Access are explained in Section Access Types for Registers.
